Their unique design have made them popular among the [[Hylian]]s. This [[Weapon]] shares its elegant, silver style with the other pieces of [[Zora Gear]], such as the [[Silverscale Spear]]. Silver Longswords are commonly found around the [[Lanayru Great Spring]] and [[Lanayru Wetlands]]. A Silver Longsword can be found behind the [[Ne'ez Yohma Shrine]] in [[Zora's Domain]]. Silver Longswords are made of metal and as such cannot be burned when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], nor will they float in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, they do attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]], and they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters
